notes.title: New version released
New official map: Big Tree Climb
notes.content:
Hello unepic players!

A new awesome map created by Luminous has been included in the collection of official maps. As usual, it keeps a set of unique items.

Besides, the following bugs have been fixed:

- Game no longer crashes when menus or multiplayer menu are enabled when you die.

- Pressing the shortcut key for the character page twice no longer bugs the menu

- Toy hammer could not be recovered when dropped on the hero's home or the bank. Now it can't be dropped there.

- "Vampire Hand" picture was wrong (it had an arrow)

- The advanced editor no longer crashes when pressing '4' on the water section.

- Horgan's Axe no longers disappears when you pick it up in the "Bax Simbel" official multiplayer map.

- Sometimes you could not attack an invisible creature while seeing invisible.

And a change has been done on an item that was too OP for being level 14:

- "Ranged Anger" was too over for being a level 14 bow. dam reduced from 260 to 150, and changed "acid" by "poison".


Have fun,
fran

notes.title: Version 1.51.00: 20+, balancing and cheaters
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Version 1.51.00 of Unepic is finally out.
This patch contains these 3 features:

[b]1.- Level 20+[/b]
In multiplayer, players wil be capable to go beyond level 20, being 20+1, 20+2, 20+3...
Each extra level will grant:
[list]
[*] +5% damage in all weapons
[*] +10% damage in all spells
[*] + 25 HP max.
[/list]


[b]2.- Balancing[/b]
In order to balance the game (swords for instance were too OP) and improve it, we did the following changes:

ITEMS:
[list]
[*] Healing idol. Heal dmg reduced to 100%. Regeneration reduced to 30.
[*] Executor armor. Melee and range protection increased to 400. Mace and axe atk speed reduced to 30%
[*] Spike's eviscreator. Lvl 14->16. Dmg 275->225. Sword atk speed 40%->30%
[*] Axe of the crypt keeper. Damage 700->800
[*] Storm. Dmg 300->400
[*] Spear of Gendurion. Atack speed 10%->20%. Crit change 10%->5%  Dmg 300->425
[*] Stiven's rib. Dmg 350->400
[*] Umbra's leather armor of evasion. Lvl 14->16. Melee and ranged protection 125->100
[*] Armor of dark archer. Melee and ranged prot 125->175. Extra dmg with bows 100->150. Atk speed with bows 10%->20%
[*] Armor of Gendurion. Level needed 14->16
[*] Range Deathwearer. Bow crit change 5%->15%
[*] Blessed thornmail of Cecil. Max hp 400->500. Damage returned from melee 150%->200%
[*] Blessed platemail of Luxor. Regeneraion 11->10. Lvl needed 7->14.  Prot against melee 85->100, prot range 95->100
[*] Pieces of demonic armor. Dmg with arcane 75%->100%. Crit change with arcane 15%->5%
[*] Armor of devoted paladin. Protection against melee range and arcane 200->250. Max health 300->250
[*] Drill. Dmg 200->250. Crit change with bows 10%->15%
[*] Blessed armor of Raak. Melee and ranged prot 360->500
[*] Golem armor. General speed -20% -> -15%
[*] Fracture. Dmg 300->400. Added mace crit chance(+10%) and mace atk speed(+10%)
[*] Chap. Dmg 350->500. Added axe crit chance(+25%)
[*] Peignoir of great Occultist. Prot against arcane 100->400. Extra skeletons 1->4
[*] Rings of weapon mastery. Dmg 25->50(every ring)
[*] Rings of magic mastery. Crit chance 5%->10%(every ring)
[*] Rings of eternity. Dmg 5%->20%(every ring)
[*] Crystal of archmage. Extra dmg 10%->25%
[*] Holy cross. Extra dmg with light 10%->25%. Crit chance 5%->10%
[*] Latern of miracle healing. Extra healing speed (15)is removed. Added heal crit chance(+10%)
[*] Ashes DMG 310->375, att speed swords 10%->20%
[/list]

MULTIPLAYER

[list]
[*] Vendors in Home now sell robes and staves.
[/list]

SPELLS

[list]
[*] Throwing knive. Dmg dealt on the back increased by 50%. Extra crit chance of this knife 10%->20%
[*] Bomb. Damage is increased to 300%
[*] Wind cut. KP cost 1->2. Doesn't deal double dmg to the first enemy. Piercing dmg decreases with more enemies you hit.
[*] Ghost axe. KP cost 2->1.
[*] Wrath. KP cost 2->1.
[*] Move out. Extra speed given is increased by 50%. KP cost 2->1.
[*] Split shot. KP cost 2->1. 
[/list]




[b]3.- Anticheat[/b]

Unfortunately the number of complains due to cheaters have grown up recently. They tend to alter characters of other players, annoy them and even ruin their characters.
To prevent this, the following actions were taken:
[list]
[*] Blacklist: A blacklist of cheaters. Those in the black list will be rejected by everyone else when joining a game or session.

[*] Cheat detection: normal players will be informed if their characters have been altered somehow.

[*] Altered character detection: When entering in the "Multiplayer" section, the game scans all characters and, if any of them had illegal features, they will be informed to the player.
[/list]
So, if you are aware that someone is cheating somehow, feel free to report it and this cheater will be included in the blacklist.



That's all for now.
Thanks for playing Unepic!

notes.title: Patch 1.50.06
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

In the last months we've been working in portings of Unepic for XBOX, PS4 and VITA. 
As we are using the same source code than PC, I could not upload anything until all portings were made.
But now that they're finished I have uploaded a new patch with two new maps taken from Workshop: "Was is coming" and "The Wizard's Basement". They include new unique weapons and equipment chosen by their architects... may they be overpowered?

Due to changes in the source code for portings, glitches could appear. But I'll fix as soon as I find it out. In fact I already fixed a couple of them. :-/  Thanks for understanding.

Oh, one last thing. Another reason for not uploading own content is that I'm working in a new videogame that is keeping me very busy. A sci-fi one... I'm doing my best.

notes.title: v 1.50.02
notes.content:
Hello!

First patch after leaving Early Access is here.
It's just a bunch of bugs fixed:

 - fixed: Bonus speed for weapons have been fixed (the calculation was wrong).
- fixed: "Lifesteal" weapons only absorbs HP of monsters when killed with the weapon, not magic.
- fixed (MP): Extra Skill Points can't be set any longer in laggy servers.
- fixed: mines and web traps created by player no longer counts as an enemy for appearing ladders/doors/platforms
- fixed: Battle Cry and Move Out were not applied to allies.
- fixed (MP): "destroy barrels" scroll did not work in all types of barrels.
- fixed (EDITOR): creatures set to "big" or "small" were not saved.
- fixed (MP): Items no longer appear duplicated in non-cooperative mp dungeons.
- fixed (EDITOR): Weapon choice for creatures is now working ok.
- fixed (EDITOR): Heal spells given to mobs were not applied in their allies.
- fixed: "spawn: max number on screen" not working when mob was ally.
- fixed: "Robes skill" could not be increased when "Armor Skill" was set to the maximum.
- fixed: "cheating scrolls" in PVP are working again.
- changed (MP): Blessed armor of Raak reduced slowness from 50 to 40.
- changed: Increased attack resist from 1 to 2 in concentration robes level 11.
- changed: Increased divine favours from 1 to 2 in White robes level 11.
- changed: extra damage given by rings x2.
- changed: "Ring of the Knight" critical redced from 5 to 4.

You can find this list within the game in OPTIONS > LASTEST LOG UPDATE

Oh, by the way, very soon the "Halloween extra content" will be activated for a few days ;-)

notes.title: Update 1.48: Workshop + decorate your dungeons
notes.content: Hello! Version 1.48 is now live. What's new 1: Steam Workshop. Steam Workshop is finally operational. Find it here: Link to Workshop of Unepic Now you can upload your maps directly to Steam Workshop, and share them with the rest of the community receiving feedback. As first example I created "the maze of Harnakon", a version of the game Unepic is based in (the maze of Galious from Konami 1987). What's new 2: Decorate your dungeons. I have opened the editor I used to decorate maps. By pressing E while editing you'll have access to it. Also water and ropes are accesible. What's new 3: Anti-cheat I did a new step to prevent people cheating in multiplayer, so now "illegal items" are detected. Now it is in test mode, so if an item is attempted to be changed a message will appear. If you see this message and you did not tried to cheat, then it could be a false positive, so let me know to fix it. What's new 4: New official dungeon A new dungeon called "Scabb Dungeon" arrives from France, done by Corentin Brûlé. It is so big that he had to split it in 3 pieces. The map is funny and diverse, full of puzzles and action. For those who owns them, a few new unique items are waiting. You can see the full patch notes here: V1.48 patch notes We are in the final steps. Very soon Unepic will be set as complete and will leave Early Access. Thanks for your patience. fran

notes.title: Update 1.48: Workshop + decorate your dungeons
notes.content:
Hello!
Version 1.48 is now live.

[b]<font color=white>What's new 1: Steam Workshop.</font>[/b]

Steam Workshop is finally operational. Find it here:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=233980]Link to Workshop of Unepic[/url]

[img]http://www.unepicgame.com/img/external/unepic_workshop.jpg[/img]</img>

Now you can upload your maps directly to Steam Workshop, and share them with the rest of the community receiving feedback.
As first example I created "the maze of Harnakon", a version of the game Unepic is based in (the maze of Galious from Konami 1987).

[img]http://www.unepicgame.com/img/external/mog_500.jpg[/img]</img>

[b]<font color=white>What's new 2: Decorate your dungeons.</font>[/b]

I have opened the editor I used to decorate maps. By pressing E while editing you'll have access to it.
Also water and ropes are accesible.

[b]<font color=white>What's new 3: Anti-cheat</font>[/b]

I did a new step to prevent people cheating in multiplayer, so now "illegal items" are detected. Now it is in test mode, so if an item is attempted to be changed a message will appear. If you see this message and you did not tried to cheat, then it could be a false positive, so let me know to fix it.

[b]<font color=white>What's new 4: New official dungeon</font>[/b]

A new dungeon called "Scabb Dungeon" arrives from France, done by Corentin Brûlé. It is so big that he had to split it in 3 pieces.
The map is funny and diverse, full of puzzles and action. For those who owns them, a few new unique items are waiting.


You can see the full patch notes here: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/233980/discussions/0/540744299939624465/]<font color=yellow>V1.48 patch notes</font>[/url]

We are in the final steps. Very soon Unepic will be set as complete and will leave Early Access.
Thanks for your patience.

fran

notes.title: v 1.46.03
notes.content:
Hello Unepic Players,

We're working hard in the level editor in order to let architects custommize their own monsters and bosses, including a new AI system (so each boss will behave different). There are a bunch of maps nearly finished, so I hope we can have them soon.

In the meanwhile there's been a few changes and fixes in the game:

- new (SP): included "man","zeke" and "kroom" avatars.
- new (SP): Russian is added as lanuage in the +12 mode.
- new: If you summon a mob and, due to exceeding the maximum number of mobs, another mob in the room is killed, the word "replaced" appears.
- new: included list of languages in the +12/+16 screen.
- new: inculded "swears" and "sex" icons in the +12/+16 screen.
- fixed: dialog no longer get stuck if you press ESC continuously.
- fixed: Gadzan no longer paralyzes ice blocks (they won't run away)
- fixed (SP): Now spells are assigned by default to shortcuts of gamepad in the final battle.
- fixed (MP coop): Removed the "laboratory key" from "monteorc" scenario.
- fixed (MP contest): you no longer can capture your own flag.
- changed (MP contest): time to capture flag is now 3 seconds (instead of 10 seconds).

notes.title: PowerPlay gives 6/10 ruining the MetaScore.
notes.content:
Hello guys,

PowerPlay is giving a 6 over 10 to Unepic. The MetaScore of Unepic is very lowered due to that note because there are only 5 notes: 80,75,70 and 70.

The final note passes from 73,5 to 68 :-(

This is the review:
http://www.pcpowerplay.com.au/2012/08/review-unepic/

They are complaining about:
- side-quests: they breaks up the exploration.
- combat: not engaging.
- automatic saving: does not help.
- player dies a lot.
- inventory: management is a nightmare
- humor: well, humour is very subjective. A lot of people hates Jim Carrey's humor.

All comments are refered to the "demo" zone: the traps and fecundation quests, the "orcs" (goblins of the mine), so that makes me suspect that the person who did the review just played a few, and did not even use any of the magic schools, or played all other side-quests of the game, or challenges, or multiplayer, etc.

Sumarising, I'm afraid that the wrong person voted the game, and his score is so important that is decreasing the score of Unepic that hundred of thousands of people are seeing in the Steam shop 5 points down (from 7,3 to 6,8).

I am going to write them asking to revise the review, or be it rewritten by someone who played further. notes.title: PowerPlay gives 6/10 ruining the MetaScore.
notes.content:
Hello guys,

PowerPlay is giving a 6 over 10 to Unepic. The MetaScore of Unepic is very lowered due to that note because there are only 5 notes: 80,75,70 and 70.

The final note passes from 73,5 to 68 :-(

This is the review:
http://www.pcpowerplay.com.au/2012/08/review-unepic/

They are complaining about:
- side-quests: they breaks up the exploration.
- combat: not engaging.
- automatic saving: does not help.
- player dies a lot.
- inventory: management is a nightmare
- humor: well, humour is very subjective. A lot of people hates Jim Carrey's humor.

All comments are refered to the "demo" zone: the traps and fecundation quests, the "orcs" (goblins of the mine), so that makes me suspect that the person who did the review just played a few, and did not even use any of the magic schools, or played all other side-quests of the game, or challenges, or multiplayer, etc.

Sumarising, I'm afraid that the wrong person voted the game, and his score is so important that is decreasing the score of Unepic that hundred of thousands of people are seeing in the Steam shop 5 points down (from 7,3 to 6,8).

I am going to write them asking to revise the review, or be it rewritten by someone who played further. Also will ask what side-quests they don't like, why inventory is a nightmare, tell them that there will be a "sort inventory" option in next patch, that there is a "salvation ring" available that tells you when the game is autosaved, and that there are tones of spells to have fun with.

The more comments disagreeing the review, the more strength to make them change their mind. So, if you are playing Unepic and you think that the note and the review is unfair, please leave a comment telling what you disagree:

http://www.pcpowerplay.com.au/2012/08/review-unepic/

thanks a lot!

notes.title: v 1.43.22
notes.content:
[b]v 1.43.22[/b]

NOTE: This could be the final update from 1.43.XX
In next update version will be raised to 1.44 and will have new features you will enjoy.

Level Editor:
- changed: there can be more than one dialog in a room. They all must be occupied.
- new: "checkpoint" convert dialogs in a room in dialog checkpoints that sets the respawn position of all players.
- new: 11  tools: floors, platforms, walls and ladders that appears when kiling all enemies, liting all lights or showing a dialog.
- new: architect tool called "presence" that activates all things activable by a lever when a hero pass nearby. Perfect for traps.

[b]v 1.43.21[/b]

Single player:
- changed: Now spiked balls of boss Arbolus kicks you back.
- changed: Now spiked balls of boss Arbolus also poisons in easy mode.
- changed: New image for golden boxes.

Multiplayer:
- fixed: chat can now be invoked using a letter.
- changed: Default key for chat is T instead of Insert.

Level Editor:
- New: Now doors also admit keys to be opened.
- Fixed: name/description of bulldozer, starfish and initial positions were wrong.
- Fixed: barrel with essences only gave red essences.
- Fixed: description of liftgates were wrong.
- Fixed: the breakable wall is now working ok.


[b]v 1.43.19[/b]

Multiplayer:
- fixed: some extra items disappeared.

Editor: 
- Fixed a crash that triggered when you included more than 64 creatures in a single screen.
- Fixed a crash that triggered when removing walls from the edges of the map enabling the code to think you are stepping into "nothingness" in terms of memory
- Fixed a crash that triggered when the map attempted to work with decorations in a way that it wasn't ready for in memory. **
- Fixed a bug that doubled up entries on the "create game" listing as it read both "Maps" and "Dat" files as applicable files to update. 
- Updated some debugging tools/logs to assist in troubleshooting the evasive "save/crash" bug
- Fixed a bug that caused items from the previous room (through doors or left/right transitions) that caused objects in previous rooms to affect the current room. (Levers, spikes, etc)

[b]v 1.43.18[/b]

Extra items have been included in the single player mode.
Get more information here:

http://steamcommunity.com/games/233980/announcements/detail/2146252203557141630

- temporary removed sound for critical attacks.

[b]v 1.43.17[/b]

general:

- fixed: DUMP ERROR fixed when having more than 256 items+architects+spells+recipes.
- changed: Now tutorial lines (like "press ENTER to open the chest") includes the mapped key and the mapped controller button instead of the default key.
- new: included a sound when doing a critital attack.

multiplayer:

- new: A new type of maps have been included: the "official maps" that are dungeons created by architects that have been approved and included in Unepic.
- new: 5 new official maps for DEATHMATCH have been included (created by daver45).
- fixed: "corrupted data" should not appear any more the first time a game is created.
- fixed: a room in "exploring a hole" was changed to prevent some goblins being isolated when a floor disappear.
- changed: HP of chests in MP reduced to be broken with a single strike of mace or axe, like in single player.
- changed: ghost axe damage reduced from 200% to 100% of you axe's damage.

level editor:

- new: the editor creates a security copy of the current map everytime the map is saved. So you will have all versions since the beginning of a map.
- new: An error message appears when exceding the maximum number of monsters in a room (64).
- fixed: Fixed a bug that prevented a custom map to be loaded if it reached the maximum number of monsters in a room.
- changed: currency for architect items changed from statues to coins, making them virtually free.


Find older versions here:

http://steamcommunity.com/games/233980/announcements/detail/2163135715700556223

notes.title: Version 1.43.15
notes.content:
[b]v 1.43.15[/b]

- fixed: crash when creating a potion.
- fixed: AOE attacks no longer stops casting. 
- fixed: You could not drink potions in the "dog" quest.

[b]v 1.43.14[/b]

- changed: Swapping of players (daniel / player2) can be done with F9 and also with the "map key", so swapping can be done from a controller.

Mutliplayer:

- fixed: accidental moves due to lag have been removed (like falling when stopping too close of an edge)
- changed: HP of exploding ratmans in the level 2 boss reduced from 80 to 60, and the maximum number in the room is 2.
- changed: bats in the sewer boss no longer poison.
- changed: HP of green poisioning balls (sewers) reduced to half.
- changed: inserted around 50 arrows before the green poisoning balls (sewers) so they can be killed with a bow.
- changed: included a multiplayer room before the boss that drops a key that unlock extra loot, and also gives a hint of how to kill the boss.
- changed: "exploring a hole" can now be played solo. Multiplayer will give access to extra loot.

[b]v 1.43.13[/b]

Multiplayer:

- fixed the "data error" when loading a map for the first time.
- inserted a new debug LAG number to check a possible faster way to avoid big lag.

[b]v 1.43.12[/b]

- IMPORTANT memory leak removed.

[b]v 1.43.11[/b]

- inserted robes and staves in single player.
- changed: jump reachs a few pixels further.

Multiplayer:

- changed: boss twilight now has more protection against melee weapon, frost, fire and arcane attacks.
- changed: orb or rebirth no longer removes already learnt spells. IMPORTANT: The price of this item and how to get it may change in the future.

Level editor:

- editor fixed: mouse grid no longer works when the menu is active
- editor fixed: some words were missing in the new data of the session
- editor changed: map is saved when selecting "Save and Quit".
- editor fixed: Shorcuts with SHIFT and CRTL were referencing the "non editor" pannel.
- editor fixed: Initial position of players were replicated when invoking them 2 or more times.
- editor new: inserted new tool "magic starfish" that teleports you to any part of the room (selected by the mouse).
- editor new: when saving a map (name.DAT), a "edition protected" version is also created (name.MAP). This .MAP can be shared with other people but cannot be edited.

Older versions:

[b]v 1.43.9[/b]

New tools and new upgrades for the level editor:

- now the initial point of each player can be changed.
- now you can see in the darkness using a "night vision" tool.
- now you can teleport directly to any room in the map by clicking it in the map screen.
- now you can see all rooms in the map screen. Not visited will appear darker.
- inserted "recomended player num" and "recomended level range"
- now you can create/remove walls in an area selected with the mouse using the "bulldozer" tool.

[b]v 1.43.8[/b]

- fixed: hearts no longer deals 1 damage and puskback (bug from last version)
- changed: Big boulders deals 5000 dmg instead of 500.

Multiplayer:

- new: Players can now be kicked from the group.
- fixed: initial position of player 4 in Twilight fixed.
- changed: removed the empty boxes (where next keys will be) in the loot room of Twilight, in order to disappoint players.
- fixed: the name of the MP dungeon where a player is playing appears ok in the lobby.

Level editor:

- fixed: avatars in dialogs now works ok.


Find older versions here:

http://steamcommunity.com/games/233980/announcements/detail/2180021678606999051

notes.title: Now working in...
notes.content:
[b]6 September 2013[/b]

Holidays are over and I am back again, ready to roll and troll. :-)

Right now I'm working in:

1.- Insert extra items in the Steam version. By doing challenges you will get Unepic Credits that can be exchanged for special items.

2.- Dubbing to English: Around 90 actors sent their samples, and we are now selecting who will give voices to dialogs in the game.

[b]29 july 2013 : HOLIDAYS[/b]

Hi!
Unepic holidays are about to start. They will take the whole August.
During holidays a few tasks will be doing:
- Casting for voices (Unepic will have English voices for dialogs).
- Architects will design new levels using the latest tools inserted in the editor.

Next tasks in Unepic that will be done:
- Try to reduce the LAG in multiplayer.
- Uploading custom maps to WorkShop so other players can download an play them.
- Insert "special items" that will be unlocked by doing the "challenges".


[b]13 july 2013 : LEVEL EDITOR[/b]

Hi. I'm now working in some improvements in the level editor, so architects can finish their dungeons and we can all have more dungeons to play in.

[b]26 june 2013 : TEXTS PEGI12 + ARMORS[/b]

Guys, you already have 4 players in COOP. I keep waiting your feedback.
Also fixed a few problems with the groups as it was scheduled (ghost players).

Now it is time to deal with the "adult content free" texts. These texts will be optional, created for parents that want to let their children play and people who are not comfortable with currents swears + sex.

I am also working in change the calculation of reduction of armors to something better.

[b]24 june 2013 : 4 PLAYERS IN COOP[/b]

People is demaning 4 players in COOP instead of 3. Next version will include 4 players in coop, so we all can test how it works.

Besides, looks like there are still problems in the automatic group finder. I am also working in this.

In the meanwhile I am looking for a solution to share items. It is a very hard problem but I am still investigating.


[b]20 june 2013 : CONTROLLER BUG FOUND + ANTI-CHEATS[/b]

Two more days of burocracy and answering emails... :-/
But tonight, with the help of a player, I found the issue of shortcuts in pads and fixed it, so in next version pads will work ok.
I am also working in an anti-cheatEngine process to prevent cheats.

[b]18 june 2013 : TOWN LEVEL 1 DONE[/b]

Hi again. Town level 1 is now available in v1.43.3. There are vendors to buy weapons, armors, spells, essneces and arrows.

Next step is to fix a large number of small bugs, issues you have all reported.


[b]17 june 2013 : BUROCRACY[/b]

Nowadays I am working in burocracy: answering all emails (tones of them), answering all posts in both Spanish and English forums in the web (there are a lot), and fixing a few major bugs that appeared.
I am writting down all issues, comments and suggestions you make.

So, as I am only one and you are a lot of people, I can not do everything at the same time, so I will try to planificate.

As soon as I finish with all burocracy, the first thing I am going to work is in the "TOWN LEVEL 1", inserting vendors that sells things like basic equipment, arrows, etc. So, feel free to make your suggestions. Also will let everyone enter withtout the "key of the mine".
Feel free to write your suggestions about "TOWN LEVEL 1".

Please, avoid other comments of other things. We wil deal with everything at its time.
